title: Getting help, support & community
content:
## Where to get help

We're here to help you succeed with Emergent. Whether you have a question, need troubleshooting support, or want to connect with other builders, you have two main channels.

### Discord community

Join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/emergent) to:

- Ask questions and get quick answers from the community
- Share what you're building and get feedback
- Learn tips and workflows from experienced users
- Stay up to date with platform announcements

The Discord is the fastest way to connect with both the Emergent team and other builders.

### Support email

For issues that require account-level assistance or private discussion, email us at **support@emergent.ai**.

We typically respond within one business day. Support email is best for:

- Billing and subscription questions
- Account access issues
- Detailed bug reports
- Feature requests that include sensitive information

---

## Filing a good bug report

When something goes wrong, a detailed bug report helps us fix the issue quickly. The most important piece of information is your **Job ID**.

### Include your Job ID

Every build or operation in Emergent has a unique Job ID visible in the workspace. To find it:

<Steps>
<Step title="Locate the Job ID">
Look in the bottom-left corner of the workspace sidebar or in the job history panel. It's a string like `job_abc123xyz`.
</Step>

<Step title="Copy the full ID">
Click to copy or select and copy the entire Job ID string.
</Step>

<Step title="Include it in your report">
Paste the Job ID in your Discord message or support email. This lets us look up the exact context of your build.
</Step>
</Steps>

<Tip>
If you have multiple jobs related to the issue, include all relevant Job IDs.
</Tip>

### Add screenshots of errors

A screenshot of the error message or unexpected behavior provides critical context. Capture:

- The full error message text
- Any red error banners or console output
- The state of the workspace when the issue occurred

### Describe what you expected vs. what happened

A quick sentence or two helps us understand the gap:

> "I asked the agent to add a login page, expected it to create `/login`, but it created `/signin` instead and broke the routing."

This context, combined with your Job ID and screenshot, gives us everything we need to investigate.

---

<Info title="Learning resources">
If you're new to Emergent, check out [Your first build](/your-first-build-walkthrough) for a guided walkthrough, or visit [How apps work here](/how-apps-work-here-mental-model) to understand the platform's mental model.
</Info>
description: 1. Where to get help: Discord community, support email.
